defect: From the consolidated view (view=app) a confirmed leader's governance submissions (idea, teamUsage, toolCheck-review-request) never carried the reviewPriority mark: AiCoeFrontDoor mounted SubmissionProvider over the ungated services.governance and AppShell handed the gated bundle only to its sections' FrontDoorProvider. So the request row never took Priority High and the use case never got a NextReviewDate.
hazardFound: The recovery record (DurableSubmissionService) digests {workflowType, payload}. Re-deciding the mark on a retry from the current membership changes the digest whenever the membership changed or had not answered yet, and for every pending record made by a build that never marked; the record then refuses the retry and every later submission for good. Shown by stage 2 below.
fix: components/app/AppShell.tsx: SubmissionProvider over gated.services.governance around the section body; the resolution is memoised on [roleState, isAdmin] so the facade changes only with the membership.
components/AiCoeFrontDoor.tsx: no root SubmissionProvider for view=app (legacy and page views unchanged).
services/gatedServices.ts gateGovernance: passes restoreSubmission through (called on the service), adds prepareSubmission, prepares only new submissions and sends a retry (intakeId given) untouched.
context/SubmissionContext.tsx: submit keeps the prepared payload as the attempt; a retry is never prepared again.

failures: retry refused before the membership answered
retry refused after leaving the leaders group

case sent before the membership answered never completes
